overview: Work measures energy transferred by a force. Power measures how quickly that energy transfer happens.
genZNote: Same energy transferred, but power is the one that's in a hurry.

aspects.label: Definition
aspects.valueA: Energy transferred when a force causes displacement (W = F·d·cosθ).
aspects.valueB: Rate at which work is done or energy is transferred (P = W/t).

aspects.label: Depends on Time?
aspects.valueA: No — only on force and displacement.
aspects.valueB: Yes — the same work done faster means higher power.
